rationale: The message reports implemented work ('I added README-style -h output', 'TOML scalar works now') and then requests another agent to make a specific fix ('Please fix scalar inline arrays'). It is therefore mainly a result delivery with a follow-up delegation request; it also gives current status on remaining behavior.
